thread:
anya: quick heads-up — my PR for the "Error Ref: transient signals" page failed snippet CI. The golden outputs differ across runs because Node sometimes surfaces `stream-reset` while Python shows `429` with Retry-After. PR: https://git.redwood/infr/docs/pull/722

carmen: can you paste the failing CI link?

anya: https://ci.redwood/infr/snippets/722. Golden diff shows either `>> RETRY: 429 (retry-after=2)` or `>> RETRY: stream-reset` depending on the simulated harness. That makes the prose inconsistent.

igor: runtime note: servers under pressure may close connections (we surface as `STREAM_RESET` code) instead of returning 429. Docs should teach readers to unify signals into a single `shouldRetry` decision and prefer `Retry-After` when present.

carmen: suggestion: add a tiny language-agnostic helper `normalizeTransient(err, headers)` which returns `{shouldRetry, reason, retryAfter}`. Then change examples in JS/Py/Go to call it so goldens are stable.

anya: yes — and add micro-eval with three deterministic cases: 1) 429 + Retry-After, 2) stream-reset, 3) success. Include explicit expected log lines so the snippet harness has stable goldens.

igor: also call out idempotency: "Do not auto-retry non-idempotent writes without idempotency keys; instead return an error suggesting a retry or surface a retry token." Short checklist item in the guide.

docs-bot: snippet-lint: mismatch count: 1. Recommendation: add fixed seeds and explicit expected lines to micro-eval.

carmen: I'll add the helper and micro-eval YAML, and produce small JS+Python snippets that call it. Keep examples < 20 lines and avoid referencing internal header names.

snippets-bot: holding snippet publish until micro-eval added and golden outputs stabilize.

anya: thanks — once PR updated and CI green I'll fix the runbook anchor to `#transient-signals` and merge. ping me for review when ready. :+1:
